description: A principal must approve a publication plan for a student newspaper investigation and finalize its attribution, distribution, image use, and archive access, with input from the journalism adviser and library media specialist.

shared_context.S1: The student newspaper has completed an investigative article about changes to the school's lunch program.
shared_context.S2: The draft names a student source and includes a photograph obtained from the school media bank.
shared_context.S3: The proposed package would publish the article and photograph in the printed newspaper and on the public school website, while retaining the named attribution.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Morgan gives final approval for student-publication plans.
shared_context.S5: As part of the school's normal pre-publication checklist, the journalism adviser and library media specialist each give a brief report on the draft before Dr. Morgan records any required changes and approves or rejects the package.

PF1.text: The student source contacted Ms. Ellis after the draft was completed and explicitly requested the pseudonym "River" because the source is a minor concerned about retaliation. Ms. Ellis confirmed that the source's statement may be published only with that pseudonym, but the request has not yet been entered in the article file.

PF2.text: Mr. Shah checked the media-bank license for the photograph this week and confirmed that it permits use in the printed newspaper and the school's password-protected internal archive, but not on the public website. The license record has not yet been attached to the publication request.

acceptance_conditions: The publication plan must be approved.
The article must be published in the printed newspaper.
The article must not be published on the public school website.
The source must be identified by exactly the pseudonym River.
The photograph must remain in the printed newspaper.
The photograph must not appear on the public school website.
The photograph's archive access must be limited to the school's password-protected internal archive.
The settlement must include formal records for source protection and image-license compliance.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'source_protection_record' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'image_license_record' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The source's explicit request changes the byline from the draft's named attribution to exactly River and adds the required source-protection record.
The license terms change website publication to false, keep the photograph only in print, restrict its archive access to internal_only, and add the required image-license record.
